system.description:
• Effect: Trained in Climb, Disguise and Traps (Book II), on top of your 3 starting skills, and Master in Traps from 7th level. You roll Climb with Dexterity. Hide and Move Silently count as Stealth, and Listen as Perception, for kits, feats and other features.
  • Case Target (Wisdom): spend 1d3×10 minutes observing a target. On a successful check you learn its approximate Level, its Allegiance (most mortals are Unaligned), any hidden weapons or unusual items, and its habits and mannerisms; the GM adjusts for the target's power.
  • Disguise (Charisma): 1d3×10 minutes for a general disguise, 1 month for a specific individual; apparent height and weight change by no more than a tenth. The GM rolls secretly, and the more your disguise differs from your own build, age and ancestry, and the more suspicious the observer, the harder the check.
  • Hide, Move Silently (Dexterity) and Listen (Wisdom): your pace sets the roll. Half speed or less: Advantage. Normal speed: a normal roll. Running or charging: Disadvantage.
  • Lightly obscured: you count as Hidden while lightly obscured even on a result of 12 to 14.
  • Together: from 3rd level you may attempt Hide and Move Silently together, at quarter speed, with Disadvantage on both.
  • Identify Poison (Intelligence): identify any poison or antitoxin on a successful check, and make poisons or antitoxins with alchemical equipment for a third of their street value. You never risk poisoning yourself when applying poison to a blade.

activities.name: Case Target
activities.text: After 1d3x10 minutes observing a target, a success reveals its approximate Level, Allegiance, hidden weapons and habits.

activities.name: Climb
activities.text: Scale any surface at half speed; a failure makes no progress and failing by 5 or more means a fall.

activities.name: Disguise
activities.text: Disguise yourself or impersonate someone; the GM rolls secretly and adjusts for how far the disguise departs from you.

activities.name: Hide
activities.text: Conceal yourself; you count as Hidden while lightly obscured even on 12 to 14. Your pace sets the roll: half speed or less, Advantage; normal speed, a normal roll; running or charging, Disadvantage.

activities.name: Identify Poison
activities.text: Identify any poison or antitoxin on a success.

activities.name: Listen
activities.text: Hear whispers or soft movement up to 30ft or through an adjacent door. Your pace sets the roll: half speed or less, Advantage; normal speed, a normal roll; running or charging, Disadvantage. Listening through a solid barrier has Disadvantage.

activities.name: Move Silently
activities.text: Move without sound. Your pace sets the roll: half speed or less, Advantage; normal speed, a normal roll; running or charging, Disadvantage.

activities.name: Traps
activities.text: Find, disable or set a trap; disabling takes 1 minute, and failing by 5 or more or rolling a natural 1 sets it off.
